notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 16, 2025
notes.notes:
- Adjusted lava rock spawns to prevent an exploit where players could get too far from the spawn to be hit
- Added time and height to the HUD
- Changed survival time and best survival time on the end screen to show in {min:sec} instead of just seconds
